rows.context_and_review_note: Retained Colour-difference limit: tilist n umzaray n iklan. The attached-state umzaray fits the genitive compound and explicitly disambiguates tolerance from social tolerance or a geometric radius. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:767 provides the Fill slider with maximum 100; ScanlineFill.kt:15 squares the integer value, :27 exact-compares at zero, and :28–32 sums squared RGBA differences against the clicked seed colour. The label correctly names a colour-difference threshold, not a percentage, spatial tolerance, opacity or difference from the replacement foreground colour. Longer than English; no compact-panel fit is certified.

rows.backtranslation: Tap an enclosed area. Adjust the colour-difference limit so the fill also includes close/similar colours.
rows.context_and_review_note: Retained Tap an enclosed area and adjust the same colour-difference limit to include close colours. iqqnn is a relative closed/enclosed predicate on the area; it is not a finite masculine verb requiring mechanical feminine agreement. aktur is the filling action, and ismun with the explicit colour object is a functional include/gather construction. iqrben describes similarity of COLOURS after the named colour-difference threshold, not pixel spatial proximity. ScanlineFill grows connected horizontal runs and adjacent rows from the tapped seed, matching candidates against that seed; this is not global replacement of all similar colours. The instruction does not promise that every slider adjustment broadens the set or that a drawn boundary can never be crossed at higher tolerance. Retained as contextual direct language rather than expanding the short help into an algorithm explanation. P3 companion remains P3.
